title: Corbell first meets Bob Lazar at John Lear's house
place_text: John Lear's house, Las Vegas, Nevada

tellings.quote: Oh, and he goes, "Lazar's coming over." It's first thing he says to me.

plain: Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who makes documentaries about UFOs, told podcast host Jesse Michels how he first met Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on recovered flying craft at a secret Nevada site. Corbell says it happened in the 2010s at the Las Vegas house of John Lear, a figure in UFO circles, and that the first thing Lear said to him was that Lazar was coming over.
